# Sandustry Modding Docs

> Agent discovery for the Sandustry modding docs site.
> Load the Open Knowledge Format bundle before deep reads.
> Do not invent Sandkit APIs.

## OKF bundle (start here)

- [OKF agent rules](/okf/AGENTS.md): game-only scope for OKF content
- [OKF index](/okf/index.md): Open Knowledge Format v0.2 root and domain listings
- [Consume playbook](/okf/consume.md): how to load knowledge in order
- [Live session](/okf/live/index.md): MCP attach, evaluate, triage, void-world batches

## Site context

- [OKF bundle root](/okf/index.md): raw markdown for game knowledge (agent-first)
- [Tools](/tools/): browser tools. Save editor at `/tools/map/`
- [Human home](/README.md): landing page for contributors and readers
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): repo rules for agents editing this site
- [Official Sandkit API](https://sandustry.com/sandkit.html): signature truth for runtime API shapes
